package practiseCF;

import fastIO.InputReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class TaskC {
    public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
//        System.out.println(Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(0.5)));
        int n = in.nextInt();
        if(n >= 100) {
            out.print(0);
        } else {
            List<int[]> coords = new ArrayList<>();
            for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int[] p = new int[5];
                p[0] = in.nextInt();
                p[1] = in.nextInt();
                p[2] = in.nextInt();
                p[3] = in.nextInt();
                p[4] = in.nextInt();
                coords.add(p);
            }

            boolean[] bad = new boolean[n];

            for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for(int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for(int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if(i == j || j == k || k == i) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        long ax = coords.get(j)[0] - coords.get(i)[0];
                        long bx = coords.get(j)[1] - coords.get(i)[1];
                        long cx = coords.get(j)[2] - coords.get(i)[2];
                        long dx = coords.get(j)[3] - coords.get(i)[3];
                        long ex = coords.get(j)[4] - coords.get(i)[4];

                        long ay = coords.get(k)[0] - coords.get(i)[0];
                        long by = coords.get(k)[1] - coords.get(i)[1];
                        long cy = coords.get(k)[2] - coords.get(i)[2];
                        long dy = coords.get(k)[3] - coords.get(i)[3];
                        long ey = coords.get(k)[4] - coords.get(i)[4];

                        double val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey;
                        long m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex;
                        long m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey;
                        val = val / Math.sqrt(m1);
                        val = val / Math.sqrt(m2);
                        if(Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(val)) + 0.000000001 < 90) {
                            bad[i] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            int count = 0;
            for(boolean b : bad) if(!b) count++;
            out.println(count);

            for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if(!bad[i]) {
                    out.println(i + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
